title: Zephyr: protect_request (encrypt)
notes: Reworked Zephyr oscore_protect_request around an explicit atomic sender-sequence reservation and context snapshot. All input/plaintext/output bounds and canonical OSCORE option construction complete before persistence; the next unused SSN is persisted before encryption; failures before durable persistence conditionally roll back only this reservation; context identity/key/IV/KID/KID Context/EUI are revalidated after the unlocked callback; caller lengths and option remain unpublished until encryption succeeds. Requests now include KID Context when present. The terminal RFC 8613 40-bit PIV 0xffffffffff is usable exactly once, with a 2^40 exhausted sentinel and non-underflowing remaining/freshness accounting. Added rollback/no-publish/NVM retry/max-PIV/replay regressions, fixed test SSN widths and a malformed Uri-Path fixture. Preserved concurrent response, replay, active-slot, and NVM hunks; untouched accumulated OSCORE hashes stayed stable. Gates: isolated qemu_x86 build/link PASS; all Zephyr OSCORE suites 33/33 PASS; Python OSCORE/parity 23 PASS; Rust lichen-oscore no-default-features 24 PASS, 1 ignored generator; relevant cppcheck PASS (one pre-existing const suggestion); git diff --check PASS. clang-format/clang-tidy unavailable locally.
close_reason: Implemented and verified durable request encryption, rollback/fail-before-publish behavior, canonical option construction, and terminal 40-bit PIV handling.
